title: Search Citation Candidate
description: A single search result shaped for verbatim-or-abstain citation. A citation with evidence_tier 'content' may be used as an authority directly; 'snippet' is a lead that must be resolved to operative text before it can be cited.

verbatim.description: Operative text returned verbatim by the engine (title + snippet), or fetched page text when evidence_tier is 'content'. Non-empty is the verbatim-or-abstain gate.

retrieved.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the ORIGINAL retrieval. MUST survive cache hits — never overwritten with the cache-hit time, or the freshness validator silently stops working.

engine.description: Provenance: which index answered (google-cse | gemini | ddg | brave | yandex | baidu | mojeek | primary:<site>).

jurisdiction.description: Regulatory regime / index jurisdiction. Divergence across jurisdictions is signal, not noise.

rank.description: Position in the engine's own result set.

evidence_tier.description: snippet = engine title+snippet (a lead, NOT citable under verbatim-or-abstain). content = fetched operative text (citable). A summarized/answer field is always 'snippet'.

title.description: Result title, for display and for resolving a snippet lead to its source.
